purpose: Consumer reading app and responsive Web; not a diagnostics dashboard

tokens.typography: Platform Chinese sans-serif; explicit heading/body/label/control scales
tokens.icons: Consistent outline navigation/actions; selected state uses accent

desktop_detail.layout: Quiet full-width topbar; centered open content; cover left and metadata/actions right; full-width catalog below divider
desktop_detail.responsive: Below 768px use the mobile-detail composition; preserve whole-page scrolling and no inner catalog scroll trap
desktop_detail.data_exceptions: Title, author, description, source, counts, resume and chapter labels/status must come from real data; pictured cover and counts are fictional samples, never seeded product data

implementation_inventory.continue_reading: Reuse continueRead and explicit identity routing; do not override chapter selection with history
implementation_inventory.start_reading: Retain startRead as a secondary accessible option, not a second competing filled CTA
implementation_inventory.download_management: Reveal existing local manager when local content exists; retain online exact-ID download selection and update preview; never turn a local entry into silent online reading
implementation_inventory.check_updates: Reuse mountMangaUpdatePreview; keep ID warnings and confirmed missing-list submission
implementation_inventory.export_zip: Wire existing /api/manga/<source>/<comic_id>/zip only when downloaded content exists; show actionable failures, do not silently navigate on error
implementation_inventory.overflow: Replace numeric prompt with accessible named actions; preserve copy title, copy link and metadata-only chapter report; destructive actions retain confirmations
implementation_inventory.favorites: Existing toggleFav/loadFavState with pending/error/disabled states; bookmark selected state must reflect server result
implementation_inventory.metadata: Unbox author/tags/date; preserve optional fields and local cover privacy; description expand is a native disclosure
implementation_inventory.catalog: Preserve existing volume-first identity/index mapping, bounded rendering and chapter finder; visual row style must not change original route indices

known_reference_adjustments_before_code: Generated image shows both topbar overflow and inline More; consolidate to one semantic action menu in implementation to avoid duplicate controls
Generated chapter-row icons are redundant with group headings; use existing consistent outline family and omit decorative duplicates if needed for mobile density
Concept combines illustrative 60-unit total with shortened visible groups; actual counts must be computed from actual catalog and never copied from image
desktop_detail.remaining: No rendered implementation yet; browser interaction, responsive screenshot comparison and real-device parity are required before claiming redesign completion

mobile_detail.utility_actions: FlowRow: check updates, export ZIP, More; top-up only when current catalog has missing units
intentional_incremental_differences: No new icon assets in this action-only increment
Book header, favorite placement, metadata and catalog heading still require the remaining redesign
Generated cover/counts remain concept-only; test screenshot uses no-cover fixture
AVD capture 1080x2400 differs from 1024x1536 concept; no pixel-perfect full-page claim
mobile_detail.catalog_order: 整卷优先，单话在后；真实身份与读取入口规则不变
mobile_detail.scroll: Entire content scrolls; tool area must not trap chapter viewport

mobile_favorites.unread_source: Actual server read-set-based unread count, never highest chapter or resume position
mobile_favorites.grid: Three equal cover columns on target mobile width; responsive adaptation must retain legibility

asset_constraints: Generated covers are fictional concept illustrations, not real source covers or downloadable reading content
Never crop the concept into shipped interactive UI
Implementation must keep actual covers, real metadata and real application state
Code-native controls, text, focus, accessibility and destructive-action confirmations are mandatory
verification_before_completion: Extract final component typography and layout dimensions before implementation
Render actual app and Web with representative data
Inspect concept and implementation screenshots together
Check copy, hierarchy, colors, typography, spacing, icons and responsive behavior
Revalidate local/online catalogs, volume order, favorites, download status, explicit chapter selection and progress
No claim of complete redesign or 3.0.0 release until all main surfaces and real-device flows pass
